values./system/description:
A long, sharp knife designed to hack through dense or tough vegetation, the same properties that make it a useful tool also make it an effective weapon. While some machetes found in the wasteland were purpose-made blades, others are makeshift tools, typically made from a sharpened metal blade such as that salvaged from a lawnmower, bolted, tied, taped, or otherwise affixed to a simple handle.

Machetes can accept the following mod which is installed with the Repair skill:

  • Machete: Serrated Blade
